hypotheses.R0_symmetry_quotient_is_exact: The 16 I/B layer-subset paths exactly recompose the 81 I/L/R paths with maximum relative error at most 1e-6.
hypotheses.R1_frozen_four_group_program_is_compact: Four discovery-frozen symmetry-invariant groups retain at least 0.85 Jacobian fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.R2_frozen_eight_group_program_is_high_fi: Eight discovery-frozen groups retain at least 0.95 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.R3_group_program_beats_uniform_random: At budget four, the frozen program exceeds the uniform random-subset 95th percentile by at least 0.05 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R4_group_program_beats_degree_matched_ra: At budget four, the frozen program exceeds the degree-profile-matched random 95th percentile by at least 0.03 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R5_degree_one_truncation_explains_compac: The discovery-free program containing the residual path and all four one-bilinear-layer paths has at least 0.85 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.R6_context_specific_group_selection_is_s: At budget four, the per-example oracle exceeds the frozen program by less than 0.05 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R7_group_program_transfers_ood: Frozen four-group fidelity on each OOD corpus is within 0.05 of FineWeb.
hypotheses.R8_group_program_predicts_finite_effects: The frozen eight-group tangent predicts finite attention-frozen MLP effects with at least 0.90 fidelity on every corpus.
